verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the CTA sits at the top, the headline is shrunk to small text under it, and the four bullets are scattered around the can in different corners (1 top-right, 4 left, 3 right, 2 below). The tiny logo is pushed into the bottom-left corner, and the legal line is as large as the body copy. B keeps the headline dominant and the CTA clear, but it is still broken: the bullets are out of order and sized inconsistently ('Wild honey' is unreadably small), the tagline is jammed between the bullets, the legal text is set at body size and competes with them, the logo pill is oversized, and the can is crammed into the bottom-right corner.
